notes.root_cause: hsk-studio-type/src/area_text.rs compose at d208bc0e lines 617-620: an empty line that cannot hold the word skips the band whenever avail < full (bbox width - 2 inset), with no check that any later band can hold it. Viewer frame after one direct drag of anchor (40,30) -> (90,60): convex quad 10,10 / 40,10 / 90,60 / 10,30 (no self-intersection, area 1150, bbox 80 pt wide). Ubuntu-Light 12 pt: 'Overset' = 42.468 pt; bands: [10,40] 30 pt, [20.38,54.4] 34.02 pt, [58.78,68.8] 10.02 pt, the 4th ends at 62.69 > 60. Every band is narrower than the bbox and than the word, so all were skipped and 0 of 32 placed; the 30 pt rectangle is full-width, so it broke the word (4 placed). Not the cause (checked): viewer drag geometry (valid convex quad), inset (0), flattening (straight edges), auto-size (off), first baseline (19.312 as in the rectangle).
